content.short: Blockchain at San Diego is a research centre exploring blockchain technology.
content.description: The Blockchain Lab at UC San Diego advances research and development to tackle core blockchain challenges like scalability, security, and interoperability. By pursuing practical solutions, their work has implications across industries such as finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. UC San Diego students can study the latest blockchain advances, engage with researchers and industry experts, and collaborate to design and prototype new applications and approaches. This collaborative environment emphasizes turning theoretical insights into usable tools with real-world impact.
